title: Poly's Enhanced GUIs
description: This pack just enhances the existing minecraft guis and makes them a bit Blue :D
body:
This pack **Enhances** the existing **GUIs** of The game by changing the colour palette from the Monotone and textured GUIs of the vanilla game to more of a **blue-ish** tone and making the guis Look way simpler while keeping the vannila **feel**

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### All general GUIs Like,

- **The crafting table, chest, large chest and furnace types**

- **The Survival and Creative Inventorys**

- **Standard Resolution GUIs Of the vannila game**

- **And SLIGHT enhancements to spesific sprites like the recipe book and the delete item texture in the creative inventory**

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
